content.comment_body: Dear [product_name] users, I will soon receive a PC with Windows 8, so I've compiled information from the [product_name] forum on how to run [product_name] V7 with that operating system. Unfortunately, I can't test this at the moment since I don't yet have a Windows 8 PC. Here are some details: 1. The installation may fail because the installer for [product_name] does not officially support Windows 8. 2. Possible workaround: a. Copy the "Windows" folder from the [product_name] V7 DVD to your hard drive. b. Change to the copied folder "Application_win32" or "Application_win64" based on your Windows 8 version (32/64 Bit). c. Run "[product_name]Comfort.exe" from that folder. I am unsure if this works for earlier versions of [product_name] (prior to V7). You might need compatibility mode to run the executable. If anyone has a Windows 8 PC, please share your experience on the following features: - Support for USB and RS232 programming cables - Online testing - Simulation - Update Center - Data log upload - I/O status recording - ... There may be some limitations, and sharing this information could benefit other users. Thanks and regards, [user_name]

I can confirm that [product_name] V7 works on my Windows 8 system (not Win8 Pro). I am using [product_name] hardware, connected via Ethernet, and another unit with USB cable and its driver from the DVD. Online testing functions correctly for me.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members discuss how to install and use [product_name] V7 on Windows 8, exploring whether the installation is possible despite official incompatibility. The topic covers alternative installation steps and asks for feedback on various features. A user confirms that [product_name] V7 runs and that both Ethernet and USB connections, as well as online testing, function properly, although some limitations may still exist.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that [product_name] V7 can be installed and operated fully on Windows 8, including features like online testing, simulation, update center, data log upload, and I/O status monitoring.
